@deskSlotNow.description: Screen-reader name of the sidebar's bottom slot, which shows what is going on now (a scan, an update, a payment on its way).

@deskSlotHelp.description: Small link at the bottom of the sidebar: opens Settings › Help.

@deskSlotOffline.description: Sidebar slot line: Offline mode is on (Settings › Advanced). Short.

@deskSlotOfflineDetail.description: After 'Offline mode' on the same short line: what it means.

@deskSlotScanning.description: Sidebar slot line while the wallet scans the chain for its outputs; the percent follows after a dot.

@deskSlotScanWaits.description: Sidebar slot line: the scan the wallet owes waits for the network (Offline mode, or the node does not answer).

@deskSlotScanStopped.description: Sidebar slot line: the scan stopped with an error; 'Try again' follows.

@deskSlotTryAgain.description: Action word after 'Scan stopped' in the sidebar slot; a click opens the scan page.

@deskSlotSending.description: Sidebar slot line while a payment is being sent.

@deskSlotPaymentOut.description: Sidebar slot line: a payment this wallet sent is posted and confirming; '2 of 3' (confirmations) follows.

@deskSlotPaymentIn.description: Sidebar slot line: a payment to this wallet is confirming; '1 of 3' (confirmations) follows.

@deskSlotPaymentsOut.description: Sidebar slot line: several sent payments are confirming (the least advanced one's count follows).

@deskSlotPaymentsMoving.description: Sidebar slot line: several payments, sent and received, are confirming. Short: the sidebar is narrow.

@deskSlotOf.description: Confirmations so far of those needed, after a payment line: '2 of 3'.

@deskSlotWaitingBlock.description: After 'Payment on its way' while the payment is posted but in no block yet.

@deskSlotRequests.description: Sidebar slot line: invoices that need an answer; the count follows after a dot.

@deskSlotNodeStarting.description: Sidebar slot line: the local node on this computer is starting.

@deskSlotNodeSyncing.description: Sidebar slot line: the local node is syncing the chain; its progress follows after a dot.

@deskSlotUpdateDot.description: Screen-reader label of the small dot at the bottom of the sidebar when an update is out. {version} e.g. 26.10.17.

@deskSlotOpenAdvanced.description: Tooltip line of a sidebar slot line: where its click goes.

@deskSlotOpenRecheck.description: Tooltip line of the slot's scan line: opens the Recheck balance page.

@deskSlotOpenSend.description: Tooltip line of the slot's sending line: opens Send.

@deskSlotOpenActivity.description: Tooltip line of the slot's payment line: opens the payment in Activity.

@deskSlotOpenInvoices.description: Tooltip line of the slot's requests line: opens Invoices.
